note: The review map for selected.html. It says which three featured pieces the page leads with, which four sit behind them, what capability each one is being read as evidence of, and which section of each leading piece the card opens at. Every one of those placements is a reading, not a measurement, which is why it lives here rather than in the build: the archetype, the domain, the proof callout, the note and the route label are written by the owner, and the title, subtitle, link, figure and counts beside them are recomputed from content/pieces.json and content/metrics.json on every build. What the build holds is this: the two sets together are exactly the pieces recorded as featured, no slug appears twice, every slug is listed and featured, every route names a section the piece's own invariance record holds, and every numeral in a callout, note or label is a numeral the piece itself states in its own text. A callout that says a number the piece does not say fails the build, and so does a route to a section the piece does not carry. Disagree with a placement by editing this file.
